rulesConfirmed: Do not convert a source measurement when the source unit is ambiguous.
Do not force one scalar canonical value when a specification varies materially by year/configuration.
Unknown, conflicting and not-applicable remain distinct states.
Community corrections are evidence inputs, not automatically authoritative facts.
During transition, verified legacy fields may be updated alongside canonical fields so old UI remains coherent.
Model naming duplicates should be repaired while preserving aliases/evidence.

NMBL-32-WA.notable: Published evidence supports motorsailer identity, separate shower compartment and skeg-supported rudder.
unresolved: Power-only mastless hulls exist; model-level motorsailer classification has configuration variability.

ALBN-27-FC.notable: Factory/stock evidence supports wet-head shower, not a dedicated shower stall.
unresolved: Production end year conflicts between model guide and owner-club history.
Tank gallon type is not explicit in the principal spec source, so canonical litres are not assigned.

GRBK-32-CL.notable: Core dimensions and production total are well supported.
unresolved: Hull material changes from wood to fiberglass during production; no single model-level HullMaterialCode is assigned.
Fuel capacity varies (225/250 gal); gallon basis is not explicitly labeled in the source.

CAMA-31-TR.notable: Camano handbook explicitly documents 28/31 naming history and US-gallon tankage.
unresolved: Tank capacities changed materially across production, so early/general handbook capacities are evidence assertions rather than universal canonical scalars.

CPDR-28-FB.notable: Duplicate public name fixed to Model 28 / Variant Flybridge Cruiser. Full keel and semi-displacement configuration supported.
unresolved: Draft conflict: 2 ft 11 in in brochure-derived association data vs 2 ft 9 in in HMY; canonical Draft left unset.
Production dates and tankage differ among sources/year groups.

MRTR-36-DO.notable: Duplicate public name fixed to Model 36 / Variant Double Cabin. HMY supports 36 x 12 ft 2 in x 3 ft 6 in and 21,000 lb.
unresolved: Single and twin engine arrangements exist; EngineCount is intentionally not set at model level.
Taiwan-import builder/equipment variation requires hull-specific verification.
